setup.auto_register.hint: If you tick this, the till sends its device ID, your store name, your shop's country, your shop's region and the till's software version to the Universal Till cloud marketplace, so we can help with support, updates and licensing — your address is not sent. Leave it unticked and nothing is sent — the till only registers later, when you first use the plugin store or press Register now. You can change this any time in Settings → Till registration.
setup.auto_register.label: Register this till with the Universal Till cloud now
setup.base_plugins.not_published_tax: Your %s tax plugin isn't in the plugin catalog yet — the till keeps checking and installs it as soon as it's published.
setup.base_plugins.pending: Looking for a free %s language pack — if the plugin catalog has one, the till installs it in the background.
setup.base_plugins.pending_tax: Installing your %s tax plugin in the background — this can take a few minutes if you're offline.
setup.base_plugins.title: Free plugins for your country
setup.country.hint: This sets your currency and tax — you can change everything later in Settings.
setup.country.title: Where is your shop?
setup.done.hint: You can add products, tills and printers any time from the menu. Tap below to open the till.
setup.done.title: All set!
setup.error.save_failed: Could not save your settings — please try again.
setup.error.store_name_required: Enter your shop's name. It is printed on every receipt.
setup.error.tse_identity_incomplete: Please fill in all four business fields (or leave them all empty to skip TSE setup for now).
setup.error.tse_identity_too_long: Business details can be at most 200 characters per field.
setup.error.tse_tax_number: That doesn't look like a German tax number — try the form 12/345/67890 (Steuernummer) or DE123456789 (USt-IdNr.).
setup.join.discover_help: Or find the main till automatically: make sure it is on and connected to this network, press “Find a main till on this network”, pick it from the list and give this till a name. Both screens then show the same 6-digit code — the main till's manager compares them and approves.
setup.join.help: Already have a Universal Till in this shop? On that till open Settings → Tills → Show pairing code, then type the code and the address it shows here (or scan its QR code). This till will copy the whole shop — items, prices, staff PINs — and restart.
setup.join.title: Join an existing shop
setup.language.detected_coming_soon: We don't have %s yet — it's on the way. Choose one of these for now:
setup.language.downloads_on_select: More languages from the plugin catalog — these download and install when you pick them.
setup.language.install_pending: Still installing %s in the background — continuing in %s for now.
setup.language.more_when_connected: More languages become available once this till is connected to the internet.
setup.language.title: Choose your language
setup.shop_type.hint: Optional — helps tailor Universal Till later. You can change it any time in Settings.
setup.shop_type.title: What kind of shop is this?
setup.store.title: What is your shop called?
setup.tax_plugin.description: Applies Germany's dine-in/takeaway VAT rates (§12 UStG) and signs each sale with your configured TSE. Required before you can complete any real sale in Germany — install now if you're online, or we'll keep retrying in the background until you are.
setup.tax_plugin.install_pending: Still installing the tax plugin in the background — you can continue.
setup.tax_plugin.not_published: The tax plugin isn't in the plugin catalog yet — the till keeps checking and installs it as soon as it's published. You can continue.
setup.tax_plugin.offline_note: We couldn't reach the plugin catalog to check for the tax plugin. We'll install it automatically as soon as the till can reach it.
setup.tax_plugin.queued_offline: Queued — we'll install the tax plugin automatically as soon as the till can reach the plugin catalog. You can continue.
setup.tax_plugin.skip_warning: This till cannot complete a real sale in Germany until the tax plugin is installed. We'll keep retrying in the background — you can also install it any time from Settings.
setup.tax_plugin.title: Germany tax plugin
setup.till_name.title: What should this till be called?
setup.title: Set up your till
setup.tse.custody_note: Universal Till — not you — holds this device's admin credential (PUK) and manages the signing service on your behalf. It belongs to your shop: you can request it from us at any time.
setup.tse.hint: Used only to set up receipt signing (TSE) for your shop through Universal Till Cloud — the signing service German shops use to sign each sale. We never ask for bank details here. You can skip this step and set it up later.
setup.tse.title: Your business details (TSE)
setup.update.apply_failed: Update failed — continuing on the current version. You can try again later from Settings.
setup.update.prompt: A newer version of Universal Till is available. Update now before continuing setup, or continue on this version — you can always update later from Settings.
shop_name_notice.title: Name your shop: it still has a placeholder name on receipts.
tour.basket.body: Everything the customer is buying, with the running total.
tour.basket.title: Basket
tour.end.body: You can take this tour again any time from Help → Take the tour.
tour.end.title: You're ready to sell
tour.error.signed_out: Sign in so the till can remember that you finished the tour.
tour.help.body: Opens the manual for the screen you are on, at any time.
tour.help.title: Help
tour.intro.body: A one-minute look around the sale screen. Tap Next to go on, or Skip tour to start selling straight away.
tour.intro.title: Welcome to your till
tour.nav.body: Everything beyond selling is here: stock, orders, reports and settings.
tour.nav.title: Menu
tour.parked.body: Sales you put on hold wait here until you pick them up again.
tour.parked.title: Open orders
tour.pay.body: When the basket is ready, tap Pay and choose how the customer pays.
tour.pay.title: Take payment
tour.products.body: Pick a category, then tap a product to add it to the basket.
tour.products.title: Products and categories
tour.restart.description: A one-minute walk around the sale screen: what each part is for.
tour.restart.title: Guided tour
tour.search.body: Search by name when a product isn't on screen. You can also scan a barcode at any time.
tour.search.title: Find a product
tour.session.body: Who is signed in, and the lock. Lock the till whenever you step away.
tour.session.title: You and the lock
